capture_rule: Capture the complete IUPAC Gold Book phase-rule term and the complete NIST General Discussion and Glossary of Phase Diagrams PDF byte-for-byte. Preserve every source definition, figure, page, phase classification, component classification, variance or degree-of-freedom classification, invariant boundary, source citation and adverse or metastable qualification. Register the complete finite component/phase identity product for positive component counts one through four and positive phase counts one through the component count plus the two held environmental carriers before opening any degree-support outcome. Do not use the IUPAC equation, any source degree label or any phase diagram outcome in the Fold candidate generator, eliminator, independent reconstruction or capability-closed prediction.

allowed_before_target_release: admitted finite-support, composition, mixture and equilibrium claims
admitted THERMO-001 through THERMO-010 claims and immutable receipts
positive component-count identities one through four
positive phase-count identities one through component-count plus two
source identities, locators and provenance only
forbidden_before_target_release: IUPAC phase-rule equation or algebraic rearrangement
source definition fragments that reveal the target relation
numerical zero as an SFT value
subtraction, signed count, negative, irrational, imaginary or continuum proof value
selected physical system, phase diagram or target-derived correction

external_structure_vector_identity_unive.phase_identity_rule: For each positive component-count identity, register every positive phase count from one through the complete component-support carriers plus the two held environmental carriers.
external_structure_vector_identity_unive.target_outcome: remaining independent degree-support carrier word or structural EmptyOne
